svg.title: Chunked cross-entropy: same loss, two memory bills
svg.desc: Left: ordinary cross-entropy materialises logits [N, V] = 16,320 x 8,192 fp32 = 510 MiB plus a log-softmax of the same size kept for backward. Right: chunked cross-entropy loops over 16 slices of c = 1,024 rows, computing logits [c, V] = 32 MiB, logsumexp minus target logit, adding to a running sum and discarding; backward recomputes each chunk's logits. Peak memory grows with N·V vs c·V; loss and gradients are the same at the cost of one extra matmul per chunk.
svg.text: the log-softmax and its gradient are [N, V] too
drawn to the left block's scale:

text.tspan: recompute the chunk's logits → softmax − onehot →
· costs one extra matmul per chunk
